articles.summary: PLANO, Texas --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 24, 2026-- Diodes Incorporated (Diodes) (Nasdaq: DIOD) announces its family of automotive-compliant* field-plated Super Barrier Rectifier (SBRFP) products that include the 2A SBRFP2M60P1Q and SBRFP2M60SAFQ, 3A SBRFP3M60SAFQ, and 8A SBRFP8A60P5Q.
